title: Chapter 121 Night Talk
content:
Chapter 121 Night Talk

Until the evening, the beast carcasses in Wana Village were not cleaned up.

As night fell, the cold wind blew.

Wang Shuo sat by the fire and drank with everyone to keep warm.

After this battle, the people in Wana Village seemed to become closer.

"Lord, come, I'll toast you a glass!" A blue-eyed, gray-haired man came over.

Wang Shuo remembered that this person was called Roger.

When he was caught, he even wet his pants.

"Haha, let's have a toast!" Wang Shuo laughed heartily.

"Lord, you don't know, at the beginning, I was really scared by you, but I didn't expect that after getting along for a long time, I found that you are not so scary." Roger was very relaxed at this time, casually spread his legs, leaned back, supported the ground with one hand, and took a sip of wine from the bottle with the other hand.

There was no trace of nervousness at all.

"Really? Was I so scary before?" Wang Shuo touched his nose a little embarrassedly.

At the beginning, in order to quickly accumulate people, Wang Shuo used very drastic means.

This left a bad impression on many people, but there was nothing that could be done about it.

"Were you also scared to death at the beginning, huh?" Roger was originally a timid person, but after getting familiar with everyone, he dared to take the lead in making trouble.

"Xiaoyue, were you scared at that time? Anyway, I was very scared at that time. I thought I would be killed, or..." A girl named Yan Yu also whispered to Sun Xiaoyue next to her.

These two girls, one has a tailoring profession, and the other is good at taming wild beasts. Her living profession is a breeder. If she wants, she can also learn a combat profession in the future, a tamer.

"I'm not as timid as you." Sun Xiaoyue chuckled.

However, everyone was sitting around the fire, and a man with sharp ears still heard what Yan Yu said.

Immediately asked: "Or what? You speak so casually, it's very uncomfortable!"

"In fact, the lord is young and promising, with unparalleled fighting power, and also handsome. Miss Xiaoyue, this is actually your loss."

"Hahaha..."

There was another round of laughter around!

Under the reflection of the fire, Yan Yu's charming eyes were a little shy, and her face turned red all the way to her ears.

"You stinky men, don't bully Xiaoyu anymore!" Sun Xiaoyue stepped forward and shouted to the men around.

Her breasts were already very huge, and now they were even more graceful!

Many men felt their blood vessels swell and their heartbeats accelerated.

"Miss Xiaoyue, how could we bully Miss Xiaoyu! You two are the beauties of our village that everyone loves!"

"Hahaha..."

"Who dares to bully you? I, Ladul, will be the first to disagree."

"I, Yan Fujie, will be the second to disagree."

"And I..."

"There is a girl in the village named Xiaoyue (Xiaoyu), who is pretty and kind, with a pair of beautiful big eyes..."

After a while, someone started singing.

These two girls are currently the cutest among the only five girls left in Wana Village, and have won the favor of many people.

Suddenly, there was a burst of laughter beside the fire.

In this dangerous place, the nerves that have been suppressed for too long can be relaxed in a very simple way, such as chatting, singing, and drinking.

Wang Shuo looked up at the sky when he saw this scene.

A bright moon was hanging high in the sky, but he didn't know whether those people he cared about were safe in another world!
